purpose: Locate the residual mass-ratio-four ODE nonmonotonicity after the frozen 0.125 M fine accepted-step cap, without changing the numerical generator or qualification gates.
measurements: Exact replay of all three capped waveform hashes, stage statistics, and source manifest
Unaligned whole-waveform and regional amplitude/phase error for both adjacent tolerance pairs
Common-support pre-attachment raw mode, orbital state, and frequency differences
NQC amplitude and phase coefficients, calibration conditions, and residuals

interpretation: The attribution is within one provisional waveform model. A numerical cause must be separately controlled before changing the generator; no fitted alignment, coefficient tuning, relaxed gate, or release promotion is permitted.
